items.prompt: Which base applies to minimum coins?

options.why: Paying amount zero requires zero coins; the recurrence minimizes counts from this base.
One is the empty-way base for counting combinations, not the zero-coin cost base.
Zero for every state would falsely mark positive amounts as payable without coins.
Minus one is the external unreachable result, not the cost of the reachable zero amount.

items.explanation: Zero coins pay zero amount;counting ways has a different base.
